sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in outstanding form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, and face an Alsager side rooted to the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches—a stark contrast that should see the league leaders continue their strong push.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table rivals, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in their last five, welcome Eccleshall in a meeting of top-six contenders, with Eccleshall recovering from a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals face a tricky away trip to Wednesfield Community, both fighting for playoff positions. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while struggling Shawbury United take on Barnton—a team showing resilience with back-to-back draws and a win. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills, with both sides seeking momentum after inconsistent recent form. Brereton Social host Widnes Town at the bottom of the division, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a clash between the two lowest-ranked sides. Crewe host Allscott Heath as both battle relegation form.
